description: Storymap frane di Lombardia is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by protezionecivile.servizirl.it. The storymap reproduces the contents of the book “Frane di Lombardia”, published by Regione Lombardia in 2012. The data sheets show, for the different types, some of the most significant phenomena present in the regional territory. The data and maps used are part of the IFFI Project, Inventory of Franosi Phenomeni in Lombardy. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Storymap landslides of Lombardy" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include iffi, frane. The listing shows 2018-12-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
